games.name: Limited Simulator 2
games.desc:
⭐Limited Simulator 2 is a competitive round based trade simulator, the goal of the game is to become the richest trader before the round ends! You'll do this by learning how to trade, buy, and sell limited items with users and NPCs in the most effective way.

games.name: SoulShatters Test Place
games.desc:
Teleporting to a different server = New Update. Shutdown = Emergency Fix.

In this game, it's kill or be killed. This is a fighting game, "randoming" doesn't exist.

Welcome to SoulShatters! There are many planned changes and features that aren't, won't, may, and will be in the final release.

Current Characters Include: Sans, Glitchtale Chara, Storyshift Chara, Undyne, Bete Noire, Asriel Dreemurr, Frisk, XTale Sans/Chara, Delta Sans, Glitchtale Frisk, Sakuya Izayoi, Stevonnie, and Carrot God!

Controls:

[LMB/RMB]: Melee Combat 
[F]: Block 
[R]: Teleport/Transportation 
[Left Control]: Run 
[Double Tapping any Movement Key]: Dash (Instantly makes you run) 
[MMB/L]: Lock/unlock your cursor. (Required for certain moves) 
[1-9]: Special Attacks (Will require Mana) 
[Q/E]: Change modes for certain characters. 

Keep up to date with changes, updates, and planned features.
